signal_text: A Gumroad help center article (dated July 27, 2022) stated that adding a category and tags to products helps Gumroad show them on Discover, and that if a seller has nine or more products, their product tags appear on their Gumroad profile for customer filtering.
subject_exact: Gumroad product tagging mechanics for Discover visibility and profile filter functionality (9+ products threshold)
local_qualifiers: If you have nine or more products
extraction_notes: 9+ products threshold for tags appearing on seller profile. Source dated July 2022 — UI and mechanics may have changed. Tagging described as mechanism for Discover visibility.
